forbidden_result: The compiler accepts or proceeds with an active requirement whose Acceptance is not observable.
obligations.observable_result: The compiler returns a rejection outcome for the active requirement.
obligations.state_before: An active requirement is being compiled and its Acceptance is not observable.
obligations.subject: VDD compiler
obligations.trigger: An active requirement has non-observable Acceptance.

obligations.expected_behavior: Stop processing before making any semantic model call.
forbidden_result: A semantic model call is made after deterministic source preflight fails.
Semantic compilation continues after deterministic source preflight failure.
obligations.observable_result: Processing halts on preflight failure and no semantic model call occurs.
obligations.state_after: Compilation is stopped and no semantic model call has been made.
obligations.state_before: Deterministic source preflight has failed, before any semantic model call.
obligations.subject: VDD compiler

obligations.expected_behavior: Return a structured `repair-vdd` recommendation that identifies the blocking reason.
forbidden_result: No recommendation is returned for the blocking reason.
The recommendation does not identify the blocking reason.
obligations.observable_result: The compiler returns a structured recommendation with the `repair-vdd` action and the blocking reason identified.
obligations.state_after: A structured `repair-vdd` recommendation identifying the blocking reason is returned.
obligations.state_before: Compilation has encountered a blocking reason.
obligations.subject: VDD compiler
obligations.trigger: A blocking reason prevents the requirement from being accepted or compilation from proceeding.
